content_sections.heading: About the Organisation
content_sections.text: Keralam State Electricity Board Ltd is a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 1956, with its registered office at Vydyuthi Bhavanam, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram – 695 004. In order to monitor the conduct of KSEB Limited's cases before various Courts/fora, the Board posts Nodal Officers (Litigation) at Distribution Circle level by deployment for a period of 2 years, as per B.O. (FTD) No. 648/2014 (LA&DEO/Gl./2011-12) dated 11.03.2014.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the prescribed format (annexure) and must reach this address on or before 25 November 2026, 5.00 PM: Secretary (Administration), Kerala State Electricity Board Limited, Vydyuthi Bhavanam, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram Fill in the application in the prescribed format (annexure) mentioned in the notification. Get the application countersigned by the Controlling Officer concerned, who verifies the particulars furnished in it. Send the countersigned application so that it reaches the Secretary (Administration) at the above address by 25 November 2026, 5.00 PM. The notice does not mention a postal mode or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notification is for one post, Nodal Officer (Litigation), in the Electrical Circles Kattakada, Manjeri, Tirur, Nilambur, Vadakara and Kozhikode. The vacancy of Nodal Officer at Vadakara will arise only after the retirement of the present Nodal Officer on 31 May 2027. Who can apply: Junior Assistant / Senior Assistant / Senior Superintendent of KSEB Limited. Educational qualification: Graduation from a recognized University, preferably in Law. Desirable: Interest/aptitude in conducting cases. Remaining service: The applicant should have remaining service of at least 2 years at the time of appointment. Age limit: Not specified in the notification. Pay: Not specified in the notification. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: KSEBL Nodal Officer (Litigation) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these duties and functions of the Nodal Officer (Litigation): Maintain a register with the entire details of the cases: name of Court/Forum, number of the case, particulars of parties, nature of dispute, amount involved, name of Counsel for the Board as well as the opposite party. Enter these details in the Sathgamaya Software Programme developed by KSEB Limited. Maintain a case diary with the date of posting of each case, the nature of any interim order and a brief description of the stage of each case. Ensure that version/objection/counter affidavit/IA etc. are filed in time. Be in continuous liaison with the field officers, Counsel and Corporate Office as well as the Legal Liaison Officer, Ernakulam. Ensure proper representation of the Board before the Court in time, and ensure the presence of the field officer/witness concerned during the conduct of cases, if necessary. Be vigilant that the opposite party is not attempting to fraudulently transfer immovable property to prevent execution of an order/decree; report any such action at once to the Corporate Office and inform the advocate engaged. Observe how the Board's Counsel conducts the case and evaluate whether he is loyal to the Board. Keep in constant touch with the advocate and Corporate Office as soon as a matter is decided, with the nature of disposal and the gist of the order. When a case is decided against the Board, obtain the advocate's advice on the scope for a successful appeal, the grounds and relevant case law, and forward it to the Corporate Office. Collect and forward lower court records for filing appeal. When a matter is disposed of, ensure the advocate applies for a copy of the Judgment/order that day itself and pays the requisite fee in time as per rules. If the judgment and decree is against the Board, take action for filing appeal/revision without losing even a single day, before it gets time barred. Obtain and forward certified copies of the judgment and decree/order of decided matters without losing even a single day. Ensure proper compliance of judgment, deposit of amount and recording full satisfaction. Ensure the presence of the field officers concerned during the visit of an Advocate Commission. Ensure the presence of the advocate concerned to avoid exparte disposals against the Board, and discuss material witnesses and relevant records with the Counsel. Submit a monthly progress report to the Legal Adviser & Disciplinary Enquiry Officer. Function as a Liaison Officer between the Board and other Government Offices under his/her jurisdiction. Discharge any assignment entrusted from time to time by the Legal Adviser & Disciplinary Enquiry Officer. Be properly and well dressed, preferably pants and shirts/saree or churidar, while representing KSEBL before a Court of Law/fora; casual wear such as T-shirts or juba should not be used. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KSEBL Nodal Officer (Litigation)?
faq.answer: Applications in the prescribed format must reach the Secretary (Administration), Kerala State Electricity Board Limited, Thiruvananthapuram on or before 25 November 2026, 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the KSEBL Nodal Officer (Litigation) post?
faq.answer: Interested KSEB Limited employees working as Junior Assistant, Senior Assistant or Senior Superintendent, having Graduation from a recognized University, preferably in Law, can apply.

faq.question: Q3. Is a law degree compulsory for KSEB Nodal Officer (Litigation)?
faq.answer: The notice asks for Graduation from a recognized University, preferably in Law, so Law is preferred; interest/aptitude in conducting cases is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. How much remaining service is needed?
faq.answer: The applicant should have remaining service of at least 2 years at the time of appointment.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for KSEBL Nodal Officer (Litigation)?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed format (annexure), get it countersigned by your Controlling Officer after verification of the particulars, and send it to reach the Secretary (Administration), Kerala State Electricity Board Limited, Vydyuthi Bhavanam, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram by 25 November 2026, 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for KSEB Nodal Officer (Litigation)?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of an interview by a Selection Committee chaired by the Legal Adviser & Disciplinary Enquiry Officer, with the Secretary (Administration) and the Chief Engineer (HRM) as members; a select list of qualified candidates will be published.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Nodal Officers (Litigation) be posted?
faq.answer: The posts are in the Electrical Circles Kattakada, Manjeri, Tirur, Nilambur, Vadakara and Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q8. When will the Vadakara Nodal Officer vacancy arise?
faq.answer: The Vadakara vacancy will arise only after the retirement of the present Nodal Officer on 31 May 2027.

faq.question: Q9. What is the term of the Nodal Officer (Litigation) deployment?
faq.answer: The term is normally 2 years and may be extended at the discretion of the Board, which also reserves the right to transfer the incumbent on the instructions of the Legal Adviser & Disciplinary Enquiry Officer.
